summary: Frontend-only testing of new search/sort controls on Orders, Payments, Archive tabs. All 16 UI checks passed. Sort dropdowns re-order cards correctly (price asc/desc, oldest/newest). Search filters work by name and phone. Non-matching search shows empty. Regression: create-order dialog opens, order card navigates to detail. Note: Payments sort applies per-section (pending list vs archive list) independently — visually total_value order across the whole tab is not monotonic, but each of Pending Collections and Payments Archive sections is sorted correctly, which matches the component's design intent.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentsTab.applyFilterSort has a subtle default-sort override: when sort==='date_desc' AND query is empty, pending list is re-sorted by balance DESC (highest due first). This means selecting 'Newest first' with empty search does NOT sort pending by created_at as the label implies. Consider either changing the label or removing the override for consistency.

Payments sort operates on each section (pending/archive) independently. If cross-section global ordering was intended, this needs a design decision — current behavior is per-section and matches code intent, so likely OK.
OrdersTab phone search uses simple substring includes (no whitespace stripping) while PaymentsTab strips whitespace before phone match — inconsistent behavior across tabs.
seed_data_creation: None — existing 3 orders (40k pending, 30k paid, 50k paid) covered all cases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 orders exist: Manoj/Ultra 40k pending (balance 36k), Manoj/Ultra 30k paid, Manas/Tactile 50k paid. All new search/sort features work as coded. Only nit is the 'date_desc + empty search' pending-list balance override behavior in PaymentsTab.jsx L72-75.
